title: Split the site into parcels, each with its own typology
summary:
work/parcels.json -> parcels/

/site.json + parcel.json (typology pin) and per-parcel task rows; adds project P6/P7 rows that merge the parcels.
inputs: work/parcels.json: {"split": "depth", "parcels": [{"code": "PA", "depth_ft": 50, "typology": "ID@ver" | "variant": "parcels/PA/typology"}, ...]} (north to south; the last parcel may omit depth_ft)
checks: depths > 0 and sum to the site depth
each pin loads and its plan has parcel-scope stages
manual: Agree the split and the typology for each parcel with the user (AGENTS.md section 2) before writing work/parcels.json.
